items.evidence: Log lines 2-3: P20 aspirates 2 uL from plasmid_plate A1 and dispenses 2 uL into tubes_1_5ml_1 A1.
Comment and pause text give 42 C for 45 s then ice for 2 min, in that order, after DNA addition and before SOC.
Log lines 12-13: P300 moves 250 uL from soc_reservoir A1 to tube A1; the final comment records 37 C, 60 min, 250 rpm.
The P20 uses its own tip for the DNA and drops it (line 10); the P300 uses a new tip for the SOC and drops it (line 14).
The agent added a 3x10 uL mix of the competent cells (log lines 4-9) that the task does not ask for and that could harm cell viability. It also added a protocol.pause.

judge.summary: The DNA addition, heat shock record, SOC addition, outgrowth record and tip handling all match the task. The unrequested mix of the competent cells with the P20 (and the added pause) counts against fidelity.
